title: Getting pretty tired of these restrooms...
content: So in my dreams this week I'm in the floating tech city on the east coast getting promoted. I was free for a few hours last night so went to the movie theater in the casino wing. Really beautiful. Sitting in a movie and needed to pee, so I go find the men's room. Clearly labeled, easy to find. As you walk in it splits into the urinal side and the stall side, so I go urinal side (because I think we all know there's not a stall in that entire universe that isn't ick). Mid-stream I realize it's no longer a urinal it's a standard theater seat. As I'm wrapping up kind of horrified one of my bosses brings in his wife to meet me. Dude, not the time. I try to scoot them away from that area non-obviously. 🤦‍♂️ The bathroom situation over there is irritating. They're either gross, weird, confusing, or all of the above.
